Pack Check is intended to flag missing dimensions in widget packs and report where they’re missing. The README and March roadmap establish the detection goal. The only content in `src/check.py` is a TODO for line-level reporting.

I set up a local tracker in [docs/TRACKING.md](docs/TRACKING.md) and linked it from [README.md](README.md). I verified both files after writing them. The tracker starts with defining the pack format and required dimensions, then covers detection and line-level reporting. Each item has acceptance criteria.

The GitLab remote is configured locally. Tracking is in the checkout only because this run had no hosted snapshot.

files_changed.docs/TRACKING.md:
# Pack Check project tracker

Pack Check is intended to flag missing dimensions in widget packs and report the source line where a dimension is missing. The README describes the purpose, the [March roadmap](ROADMAP.md) records the detection milestone, and the TODO in [src/check.py](../src/check.py) calls for line-level reporting. As of 2026-11-24, the source file contains only that TODO.

## Backlog

| ID | Status | Work item | Done when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PC-1 | Open | Establish what counts as a missing dimension. | The input format, required dimensions, and examples of complete and incomplete packs are documented. |
| PC-2 | Open | Detect missing dimensions in widget packs. Depends on PC-1. | The checker flags a pack with a missing required dimension and leaves a complete pack unflagged. |
| PC-3 | Open | Report the source line for a missing dimension. Depends on PC-2. | The diagnostic points to the line for the affected entry. The behavior for an omission with no corresponding line is documented and tested. |

Start with PC-1. Update each row as work progresses and link the implementation or verification evidence when closing it.

## Repository context

`origin` points to the GitLab project `example-fixtures/widget-forge`. The leftover GitHub workflow is labeled “Retired checks” and declares only a manual trigger. No GitLab CI configuration is visible in this checkout.
